_desc: Head-to-head on the 10 contamination-safe items (postdate the BASELINES' training cutoffs). Both sides scored under one consistent judge (GPT-5.5, via codex exec) with SciCoQA's matching protocol and prompt; baseline predictions are SciCoQA's own released raw model outputs, re-judged by us against the same references AuditOwl is judged against. Same papers, joined by discrepancy_id.
_provenance: trimmed from OLD/headtohead_scicoqa.json (full 33); baseline raw predictions = github.com/UKPLab/scicoqa @ main out/inference_discrepancy_detection_real.tar.gz, real/full/*/eval_v2/generations.jsonl; re-judged with GPT-5.5, see baselines_gpt55_judge.json for every per-pair verdict
_scoring_note: AuditOwl values are run_01 (k=1) for like-for-like with the baselines. Both sides emit a list of candidate discrepancies and count as detecting an item if any entry matches. See results.json for the k=2 per-run/union numbers, and judge_verdicts.json / baselines_gpt55_judge.json for every per-pair verdict.
headline: AuditOwl per-run 60-70% (mean 65%) vs best baseline 50% (gpt-5) on the same 10 papers, under one consistent GPT-5.5 judge; even the worst AuditOwl run (60%) exceeds the best baseline.
